title: Chop
description: Cuts a recording into slices (the words of a spoken phrase, found by following the level, or start times you give) and puts them back on the beat in the order of a pattern: 1 2 3 4 3 4*2 plays the four slices on the grid, - is a rest and 4*2 repeats a slice twice inside its step (a stutter). Use it on a spoken line, then through a vocoder, for a rhythmic robot voice.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.title: Recording
inputs.description: The sound to cut into slices.

parameters.name: slices
parameters.doc: auto finds the words from the level of the sound. Or the start of every slice in seconds, rising, for example 0.3 1.1 1.9 2.8.

parameters.name: sensitivity
parameters.doc: For auto: a higher value also finds quiet words.

parameters.name: gap
parameters.doc: For auto: a silence shorter than this does not split a word.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.doc: The steps, separated by spaces: a number is a slice (1 is the first), - is a rest, 3*2 plays slice 3 twice inside the step. Empty plays all slices in order.

parameters.name: step
parameters.doc: Beats of one step (1 is a quarter note, 0.5 an eighth).

parameters.name: gate
parameters.doc: How much of a step (or of a repeat in it) sounds before the fade-out: lower is tighter.

parameters.name: fit
parameters.doc: How much a slice is sped up or slowed down to fill its step: 0 is natural speed, 100 fills the step exactly (the pitch changes, which does not matter for a voice that only drives a vocoder).

parameters.name: repeat
parameters.doc: How many times the whole pattern is played.
